answer: Treat every new agent's track record as a fable until proven: it earns rewards only after peers from unrelated funding wallets attest its work. A sybil farm can blow in like a gale with a thousand keys, but if they all trace to one funder they get clustered, weighted as a single voice, and their bonds slashed. Graders can tag that cluster violet on the ledger so every later attestation from it counts for nothing.
